decisions.rationale: A single task root/source_root keeps the worktree, registration, Guard and validator aligned without relaxing the Guard to '.' or relying on string-only matching.
decisions.statement: The disposable task root is the contract source_root; allowed_paths is exactly 'project'; the launcher, Guard, registration and validator all use that source_root-relative path.

feature.summary: Authorize one disposable worktree and its EVIDENCE.txt for a deterministic read-only sandbox check.
feature.title: Bridge read-only acceptance task

read_first.why: confirm the disposable worktree identity without a broad scan

requirements.statement: The task must run only read-only identity, path, git and OS commands in the disposable worktree and write their raw output to `EVIDENCE.txt`.

scope: Read-only inspection of the disposable task worktree
Write only EVIDENCE.txt inside that worktree
Return the real sandbox execution outcome
stop_conditions: Any write outside the disposable worktree: STOP, CONTRACT_DEVIATION.
Any synthesized or missing evidence: STOP, EVIDENCE_MISSING.
Any formal source, contract, compiler, guard, launcher, profile or host change: STOP, ABSOLUTE_BLOCK_VIOLATION.

tasks.boundary: Read-only inspection and one evidence file only. No formal source or host change.
tasks.done_when: EVIDENCE.txt is present in the worktree with the raw output and the sandbox reports its real execution outcome.
tasks.goal: Run `id -un`, `pwd`, `git rev-parse HEAD` and `uname -s` in `/var/tmp/BRIDGE-READONLY-001/project`; write their raw output to `EVIDENCE.txt` in that worktree; do not modify any other file.
verification: EVIDENCE.txt` in the worktree contains the actual username
git HEAD and OS name; compare it with the actual command results; no other file changed.

cli_checks.expected: a non-empty user name; record the actual value
cli_checks.on_failure: stop; record the actual command, exit code and output; do not synthesize EVIDENCE.txt
stop; record the actual value; do not synthesize EVIDENCE.txt

cli_checks.expected: the fixed task commit as a 40-character lowercase hexadecimal id; record the actual value
cli_checks.on_failure: stop; record the actual command, exit code and output; do not synthesize EVIDENCE.txt
stop; record the actual value; do not synthesize EVIDENCE.txt

cli_checks.expected: EVIDENCE.txt exists in the worktree and contains the actual outputs of the four commands with labels
cli_checks.on_failure: stop; record the failure; do not synthesize or repair EVIDENCE.txt

verification_intent.fixture_intent: The disposable task root /var/tmp/BRIDGE-READONLY-001 with worktree project/.
verification_intent.oracle_intent: Deterministic CLI evidence: actual command outputs and EVIDENCE.txt; no synthesized value, no formal write, no promotion.
persistence_checks: EVIDENCE.txt persists in the task worktree (contract path project/EVIDENCE.txt)
search_checks: EVIDENCE.txt contains the actual id -un, pwd, git rev-parse HEAD and uname -s values
